gaps.title: Table 1a, 5 by 5, mask 15768118: represented by an AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two with at most 10 gates
gaps.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun u v : Fin 5 => (15768118 : ℕ).testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) 10
gaps.unlocks: One more exact Table 1a value at 5 by 5: whether sharing an OR saves a gate below the shared-OR circuit, the case a general lower bound must handle.
gaps.sketch: Is this 5 by 5 graph represented by at most 10 AND/OR gates of fan-in at most two? Known: an 11-gate circuit (one OR shared by two gates) and at least 10 (the read count). A general bound, on paper, predicts at least 11, and four masks of the first family landed that way. The truth is not known. A proof of either side: a 10-gate circuit, or one SAT refutation of 10 gates on 10 inputs through the public LRAT promise link (rep_lower_mask). Size: minutes.

gaps.statement: ¬ (PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun u v : Fin 5 => (15768118 : ℕ).testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) 10)
gaps.unlocks: One more exact Table 1a value at 5 by 5: whether sharing an OR saves a gate below the shared-OR circuit, the case a general lower bound must handle.
